title: Symbolic regression of the best confirmed controllers' latents
description: The concepts of compact's discovery controllers, recovered by symbolic regression (experiments/ground.py concepts, PySR 2.7.2) from the grounding of the confirmed controllers (release exp-ground-rl-confirm-32, their own rollouts, no new rollouts). By the owner's direction the concepts come from the best-trained networks (docs/methodology.md, grounding). The three best per teacher by the score each run left in the confirmation (exp-controller-rl-confirm-31, log utility minus the fixed rule on the validation links), chosen before this run: from Cubic, ctl-cubic-k7-s2 (-0.129), ctl-cubic-k16-s2 (-0.140) and ctl-cubic-k10-s1 (-0.147); from BBRv3, ctl-bbr3-k7-s2 (-0.161), ctl-bbr3-k7-s1 (-0.211) and ctl-bbr3-k7-s3 (-0.233). For each latent, with the sender's own window taken out (a linear fit on its features), PySR searches for a formula over the 8 features of the three networks' pooled path without the sender's measurements, in ms, Mbit/s or kB, with +, -, * and /, at most 20 nodes, 60 iterations, on 4000 rows of the training links' rollouts; the formula kept is the simplest on PySR's front within 0.01 of the best R^2 on the validation links. Rules fixed before the run: a formula is well recovered at an R^2 of 0.8 or more on the validation links; the single best network's concepts are its well-recovered formulas; the pooled concepts are the well-recovered formulas of all three, where of formulas whose values correlate above 0.9 in absolute value the simplest is kept. PySR's search is multithreaded and so not bit-reproducible; the seed is fixed per latent. These networks are not yet trained well (none reaches the fixed rule, and longer training is running), so this run is a first read of the method and supports no claim about concepts. The test links are not read.
run: case "$TEACHER" in cubic) R="ctl-cubic-k7-s2 ctl-cubic-k16-s2 ctl-cubic-k10-s1";; bbr3) R="ctl-bbr3-k7-s2 ctl-bbr3-k7-s1 ctl-bbr3-k7-s3";; *) exit 2;; esac; uv run --with pysr==2.7.2 python experiments/ground.py concepts "$OUT/concepts-$TEACHER" --runs $(for r in $R; do printf "%s " "$IN/runs/$r"; done)
